# Oska

> The design.

Oska 0.1.0 (pre-alpha). These docs track `main`. Every page is also served as Markdown: the same path with `.md`. All of them are in [llms-full.txt](https://oskalang.dev/llms-full.txt). The source code is at https://github.com/aparsons/oska. A program is one `.osk` file or a package: an `oska.toml` and modules under `src/`, with `src/main.osk` as the entry and `use pkg.a.b` importing `src/a/b.osk`; see [Packages and modules](https://oskalang.dev/guide/packages.md). `oskac build` compiles a program to a static aarch64 Linux executable on any host. On aarch64 Linux, `oskac run` and `oskac test` compile natively and run the executable, and `--interpret` selects the interpreter, which every other host uses; output, reports and exit codes are the same on both. See [Platform support](https://oskalang.dev/guide/cli-reference.md#platform-support).

## Docs

- [Oska](https://oskalang.dev/index.md): The design.
- [Glossary](https://oskalang.dev/glossary.md): A value.
- [Hostile <script>alert("title")</script> notes](https://oskalang.dev/design.md): Every construct here tries to get markup or script past the converter. None of it may survive as anything but text.

## Machine-readable

- [llms-full.txt](https://oskalang.dev/llms-full.txt): every page, as Markdown, in one file
- [search.json](https://oskalang.dev/search.json): the search index
- [sitemap.xml](https://oskalang.dev/sitemap.xml): the canonical URL of every page
- [latest.json](https://oskalang.dev/latest.json): the current version and the installers
